tasks.label: Check Administrator Privileges
args: $identity = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent(); $principal = [Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal]::new($identity); if (-not $principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)) { Write-Error 'Start Visual Studio Code with Run as administrator, then launch this configuration again.'; exit 1 }
